name: Kore tte, Riajuu? ~Kuro Gyaru ga, Doutei o Kyouiku Suru Sou Desu yo~
original_name: これって、リア充？ ～黒ギャルが、ドーテーを教育するそうですよ～
source:
"Hey, what the hell are you staring at? Who the hell are you again? Uh…"
"Don’t know this guy! Hey, you! What are you gawking at? Get outta here!"

In the classroom, there was a pair of sisters—completely naked.
Even if no one was around, stripping down to nothing in an unlocked classroom—what were they thinking?
Then they called me a "creepy pervert" and made me their servant, swearing me to secrecy.
Well, it wasn’t so bad—just running errands for them in exchange for some money. I didn’t really mind.

That’s how things went for a while, until one afternoon after school.
The free-spirited sisters were sitting in chairs with their legs spread, holding what seemed like a debriefing session about their sexual escapades with various guys.
Just listening to their stories made my imagination run wild with all sorts of dirty thoughts.
Before I knew it, I was hard.

"What’s with the squirming? Huh?"
"Oh, are you… are you hard!? Did you get turned on listening to us? Seriously!?"
"Well, it’s kinda obvious. You probably don’t have anyone to show it off to, right? We’ll take a look for you. Happy now?"

Realizing there was no point in resisting or arguing, I just…

translation:
“喂，你到底在看什么？你到底是谁？呃……”
“不认识这个家伙！喂，你！你愣什么？给我滚出去！”

教室里有一对姐妹——全身赤裸。
即使周围没有人，在没有上锁的教室里脱光衣服——他们在想什么？
然后他们称我为“令人毛骨悚然的变态”，并让我成为他们的仆人，并发誓保守秘密。
嗯，还不错——只是为他们跑腿，换取一些钱。我真的不介意。

就这样过了一段时间，直到有一天下午放学。
自由奔放的姐妹们坐在椅子上，双腿张开，举行一场似乎是关于她们与不同男人的性出轨事件的汇报会。
光是听他们的故事就让我的想象力变得疯狂，充满了各种肮脏的想法。
在我意识到之前，我很难。

“蠕动是怎么回事？啊？”
“哦，你……你很硬吗！？你听我们说话很兴奋吗？说真的！？”
“嗯，这有点明显。你可能没有人可以向你炫耀，对吧？我们会帮你看看。现在高兴吗？”

意识到抵抗或争论没有意义，我只是……
